s.t:
Deine Rolle
Als Product Manager BESS & PCS (m/w/d) übernimmst du die End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Produktfamilie der Outdoor-Energiespeichersysteme von STABL sowie für unsere proprietäre Leistungselektronik. Deine Mission ist es, wettbewerbsfähige, hochwertige Produkte zu gestalten, die echte Kundenbedürfnisse lösen und das Wachstum von STABL unterstützen.

Du wandelst Erkenntnisse aus Markt, Kunden und Stakeholdern in eine klare Produktausrichtung um und arbeitest funktionsübergreifend daran, das Portfolio kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Als Teil des Business Innovation Teams stellst du sicher, dass Marktfeedback klar in unsere Organisation eingebracht und anschließend umgesetzt wird.
Deine Mission
Du verwaltest nicht nur eine Roadmap – du gestaltest aktiv die nächste Generation von Energiespeichersystemen in einem hochdynamischen Umfeld. Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der groß denkt, gerne Hardware und Software miteinander verbindet und Produkte entwickeln möchte, die Kunden begeistern – für ein skalierendes und sich gleichzeitig kontinuierlich weiterentwickelndes Produkt in einer der am schnellsten wachsenden Branchen der Energiewende.
Du sammelst Kunden- und Marktanforderungen und übersetzt diese in klare Produktanforderungen und Prioritäten.
Du stellst die technische Exzellenz, die kommerzielle Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und die Gesamtqualität der Lösungen sicher.
Du agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, dem Markt sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern.
Du führst Wettbewerbsanalysen und Marktforschung durch, um Trends, Chancen und Risiken zu identifizieren. Dabei arbeitest du an Systemen, die an gewerblichen und industriellen Standorten eingesetzt werden, und sorgst für die richtige Balance zwischen Leistung, Kosten und Sicherheit in einem sich schnell weiterentwickelnden regulatorischen Umfeld.
Du bereitest strategische Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor und präsentierst diese. Außerdem steuerst du Produkte und zugehörige Initiativen über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus – von der Konzeption und Validierung bis hin zur Markteinführung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung.
Dein Profil
Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Product Ownership, idealerweise im Cleantech-, EPC-, Industrie-, Elektronikbereich oder einem vergleichbaren B2B-Umfeld sowie mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Energiespeicherung, idealerweise mit BESS.
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, Kunden-, Markt- und Geschäftsanforderungen in klare Produktanforderungen, Prioritäten und Roadmap-Entscheidungen zu übersetzen.
Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Management von Produkt-Roadmaps sowie in der bereichsübergreifenden Abstimmung mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und Fachbereichen.
Starkes analytisches und strategisches Denkvermögen sowie Erfahrung in den Bereichen Marktforschung, Wettbewerbsanalyse und Produktpositionierung.
Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, vertrauensvoll mit Kunden, Partnern und internen Teams zusammenzuarbeiten. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Strukturierte, proaktive und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise; Erfahrung mit B2B-Kunden aus dem Energie- oder Infrastrukturbereich ist von Vorteil.
Warum STABL Energy?
STABL Energy gehört zu den innovativsten Start-ups der Energiewende, ist Gewinner des ees Award 2022 , des pv magazine Award 2025 und wurde als eines der Top 100 Energy Start-ups weltweit ausgezeichnet. Wir werden von renommierten und erfahrenen Tech-VCs aus Deutschland, Dänemark und der Schweiz unterstützt.
Darauf kannst du dich freuen
Agile, offene und innovationsgetriebene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und echter Eigenverantwortung.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge zur Unterstützung deiner Zukunftsplanung.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten, ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell sowie die Möglichkeit, zeitweise aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
Digitale Essensgutscheine mit Circula Lunch – genieße dein Mittagessen auf uns!
Monatlicher Sachbezug, den du bei deinen Lieblingsgeschäften einlösen kannst.

Regelmäßige Teambuilding-Aktivitäten und Team-Events.
EGYM Wellpass – trainiere ohne Limits in zahlreichen Fitnessstudios in ganz Deutschland.
Bereit, Innovation voranzutreiben, etwas zu bewegen und andere zu inspirieren? Bewirb dich jetzt!
Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören und gemeinsam mit dir das Energiesystem der Zukunft zu gestalten! Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich zu bewerben. Unser Motto lautet „Hire for attitude, train for skills“ – deshalb schätzen wir Potenzial und lebenslanges Lernen genauso sehr wie Erfahrung.

Was wir suchen
Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Product Owner (m/w/d) für unser Tech Team (hybrid/remote).
Das sind deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Lead-Matching-Software – unserer eigens entwickelten Kernanwendung zur automatisierten Neukundengewinnung.
Du sorgst dafür, dass die Entwicklung reibungslos voranschreitet und unsere Entwickler jederzeit an den richtigen Prioritäten arbeiten.
Du konzipierst eigenständig neue Features, nimmst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen und von Usern auf und übersetzt sie in klare Arbeitspakete (z. B. Tickets, Mockups etc.).
Du prüfst neue Features auf Funktionalität und Qualität, begleitest den Release-Prozess und verantwortest den Live-Gang.
Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen I T, Fachabteilungen und externen Dienstleistern und sorgst während des gesamten Entwicklungsprozesses für eine transparente Kommunikation.
Du hältst alle relevanten Stakeholder regelmäßig über den aktuellen Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden.
Du identifizierst, konzipierst und implementierst AI-Anwendungen , die unsere Softwarelösungen und internen Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter machen – von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
Dank deiner Expertise erreichst du folgende Meilensteine bei uns

Du lernst die Leadbase (Matching, Dialer, Partner-Portal, Versand & Abrechnung sowie APIs) und die wichtigsten Stakeholder aus Vertrieb, Operations und Tech kennen.
Du übernimmst die Pflege des Backlogs sowie die laufende Priorisierung der Tickets im Tech-Team.
Du setzt erste kleinere Verbesserungen eigenständig um – von der Anforderungsaufnahme über die Qualitätssicherung bis zum Live-Gang.
Du etablierst regelmäßige Kommunikationsformate (z. B. wöchentliche Status-Updates oder Release Notes) und hältst Fachabteilungen sowie Management über den Entwicklungsstand auf dem Laufenden.

Du verantwortest eigenständig ein größeres Feature oder eine Produktinitiative der Leadbase – von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Rollout.
Du stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Fachbereichen und priorisierst Anforderungen nach ihrem Nutzen und ihrer Relevanz.
Du identifizierst konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten für KI und setzt erste Prozessoptimierungen um (z. B. zur Automatisierung von Anforderungsprozessen oder zur Steigerung der internen Produktivität).

Du gestaltest die Produktstrategie für Lead Matching und angrenzende Module (z. B. Dialer, Multi-Channel und Partner-API) aktiv mit und bringst mindestens ein strategisches Vorhaben erfolgreich in Produktion.
Du hast mindestens eine KI-Lösung erfolgreich produktiv eingeführt.
Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Produktfragen rund um die Leadbase und wirst von Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern als verlässliche Schnittstelle wahrgenommen.
Das bringst du mit
Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager in einem agilen Umfeld mit – idealerweise in einem SaaS- oder Tech-Unternehmen.
Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und hast Freude daran, die Brücke zwischen Business und Entwicklung zu schlagen.
Du hast erste Berührungspunkte mit künstlicher Intelligenz oder ein fundiertes Interesse daran, KI-Lösungen praxisnah im Unternehmenskontext einzusetzen.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und proaktiv und kannst komplexe Anforderungen in klare Aufgaben und Prioritäten übersetzen.
Du kommunizierst sicher und verständlich – auch bei technischen Themen und mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
Du begeisterst dich für datengetriebene, digitale Produkte und hast den Anspruch, Dinge aktiv voranzubringen und nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Das bieten wir dir
Ein dynamisches Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld sowie die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam “The Lead Company” aufzubauen.
Ein riesiger Markt und zahlreiche interne Wachstumsmöglichkeiten – wir lösen das größte Problem unserer Partner: die Automatisierung ihrer Neukundengewinnung.
Volle Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (remote, im Bremer Headquarter oder nach Absprache auch aus dem Ausland).
Volle Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeit – du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten individuell mit deinem Team.
30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr + die Möglichkeit, jederzeit unbezahlten Urlaub zu nehmen.
Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead‑Rente”).
Jährliche Teamevents wie Sommerfest & Weihnachtsfeier.
Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – moderne Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum unterstützen dich bei der täglichen Arbeit.
Zuschuss fürs Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club oder E‑Gym Wellpass).
Schnelle Entscheidungen – wir sind 100 % bootstrapped, profitabel und unabhängig von Investoren.
Eine offene Feedback‑Kultur und regelmäßige interne Trainings.
Transparente Kommunikation durch monatliche All‑Hands‑Meetings , wöchentlichen Newsletter und feste Team‑Updates.
Im Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt erwarten dich ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, großartiger Kaffee & Espresso, Getränke und Grillabende.
Für Home‑Office‑Mitarbeitende: monatliche Home‑Office‑Pauschale von 20 €.
Bikeleasing, lease dein Wunschfahrrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen.
Das sind unsere Werte
Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.
Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.
Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

Seit über 25 Jahren entwickeln wir bei SEPPmail Secure-E-Mail-Lösungen, die Inhalte und Absenderidentität zuverlässig schützen und Spam sowie Malware in Schranken weisen – ohne technische Hürden für Absender oder Empfänger. Über 3.400 Endkunden aus Branchen wie Medizin, Energie, Finanz- und Versicherungswesen, öffentlicher Verwaltung, Pharma und Recht vertrauen auf unsere Technologie.

Mit Sitz in der Schweiz und Deutschland prägen Offenheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Wertschätzung unsere Zusammenarbeit im Team und mit unseren Kunden. SEPPmail ist Teil von LEA Partners, einem auf Softwareunternehmen spezialisierten PE-Unternehmen mit einem starken Netzwerk an Branchenexperten.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Produktteams suchen wir eine erfahrene, generalistisch denkende Persönlichkeit mit Leidenschaft für sauberen Code und moderne Entwicklungsmethoden.
Diese Stelle ist vollständig im Homeoffice zu besetzen - Du kannst von überall in Deutschland oder der Schweiz aus arbeiten.
Aufgaben
Du verantwortest die Lokalisierung, marktgerechte Weiterentwicklung und Positionierung unserer Human Risk Management Software (Security Awareness Training und Phishing Simulation) für die DACH-Region.

Als Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Vertrieb, Produktentwicklung und Marketing stellst du sicher, dass unser Produkt den regulatorischen, kulturellen und geschäftlichen Anforderungen des deutschsprachigen Marktes entspricht – und treibst gleichzeitig Markteinführung, Vertrieb und Geschäftsentwicklung in DACH aktiv voran.
Product Ownership & Marktlokalisierung
Verantwortung für die DACH-Produktstrategie in Abstimmung mit dem globalen Product Management
Analyse von Marktanforderungen, Kundenfeedback und regulatorischen Entwicklungen (z. B. Datenschutz, Compliance, Security Awareness)
Priorisierung von Anforderungen und Pflege des Product Backlogs für DACH-spezifische Features
Sicherstellung einer hochwertigen Lokalisierung (Sprache, Inhalte, Benutzerführung, Compliance)
Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen sowie Unterstützung bei Roadmap- und Release-Planung
Sales & Business Development
Marktausbau der Human Risk Management Lösung in der DACH-Region
Identifikation neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten sowie Produktpräsentationen, Live-Demos und Workshops
Unterstützung des gesamten Sales Cycles – von der Leadqualifizierung bis zum Vertragsabschluss
Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing bei zielgruppenspezifischen Kampagnen und Vertriebsunterlagen
Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen sowie Teilnahme an Messen und Fachveranstaltungen
Customer & Market Success
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Bestandskunden zur kontinuierlichen Produktverbesserung
Entwicklung von Best Practices und Success Stories für den DACH-Markt
Unterstützung bei Kunden-Onboardings und der Einführung neuer Produktfunktionen
Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder Presales Consultant, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld (Cyber Security, Human Risk Management oder IT-Security)
Fundierte Kenntnisse in agiler Produktentwicklung (Scrum, Kanban) sowie im technischen Vertrieb komplexer Softwarelösungen
Verständnis von Compliance-, Datenschutz- und Security-Anforderungen im DACH-Markt von Vorteil
Unternehmerisches, kundenorientiertes Denken und die Fähigkeit, Marktanforderungen in konkrete Produktanforderungen zu übersetzen
Kommunikationsstärke auf Management- und Fachebene, sicheres Auftreten bei Präsentationen sowie eine analytische, eigeninitiative Arbeitsweise
Teamfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei SEPPmail übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung für die Positionierung unserer Human Risk Management Software im DACH-Markt – einem Markt mit hohen Anforderungen an Datenschutz, Compliance und Informationssicherheit. Durch die Kombination aus Product Ownership und marktnahem Vertrieb fliessen Kundenbedürfnisse direkt in die Produktentwicklung ein.
Verantwortungsvolle Position bei einem etablierten, PE-backed Marktführer im Bereich E-Mail-Security
Homeoffice bzw. remote in einem verteilten Team
Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien, offene Unternehmenskultur
Raum für Eigeninitiative und moderne, KI-gestützte Entwicklungsprozesse
Ein Team, das Wissensaustausch aktiv lebt
Perspektiven zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung im dynamisch wachsenden Unternehmen
Ansprechpartner
Sabrina Schreiber, Recruiterin bei SEPPmail

Thank you for your interest in joining Solventum . Solventum is a new healthcare company with a long legacy of solving big challenges that improve lives and help healthcare professionals perform at their best. At Solventum , people are at the heart of every innovation we pursue.

Guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence, we collaborate with the best minds in healthcare to address our customers’ toughest challenges. While we continue updating the Solventum Careers Page and applicant materials, some documents may still reflect legacy branding.

Please note that all listed roles are Solventum positions, and our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/ applies to any personal information you submit.

As it was with 3M, at Solventum all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Job Description: Associate Product Manager - RHT Marketing ( Solventum ) Solventum , a new healthcare company with a rich history Our company is built on a trusted legacy of solving big healthcare challenges that improve patient lives while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best.

People, and their well-being, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue. We partner closely with the best minds in healthcare — guided by empathy, insight, and clinical intelligence — to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. Our ultimate goal? Move humanity forward by improving health for everyone.

Because at Solventum , we never stop solving for you. The impact you’ll make in this role As an Associate Product Manager, you’ll work alongside sharp, inquisitive minds from a wide spectrum of backgrounds and disciplines.

Together, you'll explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and shape solutions that make a real-world impact by: The RHT franchise is anchored by Restrata® Electrospun Fiber Matrix, a regenerative wound care solution designed to support soft tissue healing.

Restrata became part of Solventum ’s portfolio through the acquisition of Acera Surgical in December 2025.

The APM will execute product and program launch activities, including the development of launch materials, communications, and training programs, while gaining hands-on experience throughout the product development and commercialization process.

This role will also support the coordination of project deliverables across cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Sales, R&D, Clinical, and Regulatory stakeholders.

The successful candidate will bring strong business acumen, creativity, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while contributing to the successful development and launch of innovative wound care solutions.

Become a product expert in soft tissue healing and effectively articulate the features and benefits of Restrata to healthcare professionals and sales representatives.

Understand, manage, and develop programs for assigned surgical specialties, including the overall clinical landscape and strategic positioning of Solventum products within each specialty. Build, maintain, and support relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) in assigned specialties.

Develop and deliver training programs to educate customer-facing teams on product offerings, ensuring a deep understanding across the organization. Provide technical support for RHT products as needed. Regularly participate in surgeon visits, conferences, and trade shows to represent Solventum and gather voice-of-customer insights.

Collaborate with the graphic design team to develop product collateral, including case studies, brochures, website content, and videos. Partner with cross-functional teams on product specifications and market launches, contributing strategic insights to support business growth.

Conduct customer research through surveys, focus groups, and field visits to identify opportunities for product enhancements and innovation. Monitor market trends and the competitive landscape, providing actionable intelligence to support product development and market positioning.

Your Skills and Expertise: To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or higher. Three (3) years of experience in sales, marketing, or business management within healthcare, medical devices, or other FDA-regulated industries.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include: MBA degree or higher from an accredited university Knowledge and experience in advanced wound care or orthopedic, plastic reconstruction, vascular markets and therapies.

Strong communication skills, both written and spoken Demonstrated experience managing projects with multi-disciplinary teams. Independent and strategic thinker able to make solid business decisions Ability to thrive in action oriented high accountability environment. Track record of collaborating cross-functionally that deliver results.

Work location: Remote USA Travel: May include up t o 30-40% predominantly domestic travel (international travel on occasion) Relocation Assistance: Not Authorized Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Pay Transparency Applicable to US Applicants Only: The expected compensation range for this position is $120,000.00, which includes base pay plus variable incentive pay, if eligible. This range represents a good faith estimate for this position.

The specific compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant knowledge, training, skills, work location, and/or experience.

In addition, this position may be eligible for a range of benefits (e.g., Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Accounts, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Disability Benefits, Life Insurance, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences and Retirement Benefits, etc.).

Additional information is available at: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/our-company/careers/#Total-Rewards https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/our-company/careers/#Total-Rewards Supporting Your Well-being Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially.

To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope. Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of @solventum.com . Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

Please note, Solventum does not expect candidates in this position to perform work in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County. Solventum is an equal opportunity employer.

Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly. About You You are an AI Technical Product Manager who is passionate about building AI-powered products that solve real business problems and deliver measurable value. You thrive at the intersection of business, technology, and artificial intelligence, translating strategic objectives into scalable product solutions.

You enjoy working with cross-functional teams, defining product vision, prioritizing initiatives, and driving AI adoption across the organization. You are analytical, customer-focused, and comfortable balancing business needs, technical feasibility, and user experience to maximize the impact of AI investments.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner. 3+ years of experience managing enterprise software products and product roadmaps.

Proven experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and managing product backlogs. Strong understanding of Machine Learning fundamentals. Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and Prompt Engineering.

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, and Enterprise Knowledge Bases. Experience defining KPIs, measuring product performance, and driving user adoption. Ability to translate business requirements into user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria.

Experience leading Agile product delivery with cross-functional teams. Understanding of Data Governance, Analytics, Responsible AI, and AI governance principles. Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills. Advanced English proficiency.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Define and maintain the AI product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives. Prioritize product initiatives based on business value, technical feasibility, ROI, and organizational impact. Own and manage the AI product backlog throughout the product lifecycle.

Translate business requirements into user stories, product requirements, and acceptance criteria. Lead AI product discovery sessions with business stakeholders. Drive the evolution of AI knowledge bases, Semantic Search, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Enterprise Intelligence capabilities.

Partner closely with Engineering, Data, Operations, and Executive Leadership to successfully deliver AI-powered products. Drive stakeholder engagement, product adoption, organizational alignment, and change management initiatives. Define, monitor, and optimize product KPIs, business outcomes, and value realization metrics.

Ensure Responsible AI, governance, compliance, and best practices are incorporated throughout the product lifecycle. Continuously improve AI products through customer feedback, experimentation, and iterative delivery.

Communicate AI capabilities, risks, limitations, and opportunities to both technical and business audiences. 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner. Experience building AI-powered products, including Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, or AI Agents. Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, KPIs, and managing product backlogs.

Strong understanding of Machine Learning concepts and AI governance. Advanced English proficiency. About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact.

As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale. Originally posted on Himalayas

We are a product-driven organization building technology that unlocks the value in video and image data without compromising the people it captures. As part of Milestone Systems, we bring together anonymization and responsibly sourced, fully traceable video data with specialized AI models across our product portfolio.

We are seeking an ambitious Product Manager driven by customer satisfaction, product success, and opportunities for growth. You will work with customers, commercial and development teams, and senior management to align on a product vision, define a roadmap, and bring stakeholders together to continuously develop our product strategy.

If you understand the software-as-a-service business model and AI and computer-vision technologies, this role is for you. You must have a passion for great customer experiences paired with strong product skills. This is what will make you successful in this role.

You will define a product vision together with the Director of Product and the product team, set strategic priorities, and translate this vision into a product roadmap supported by meaningful KPIs.
You will approach customers and stakeholders with genuine curiosity and translate these insights into ideas and actions that delight them.
You will act as the strategic link between product vision and technical execution and be responsible for product ownership across the development teams.
You will identify opportunities for new products and product improvements by researching markets and interacting with customers, potential customers, and partners.
You will collaborate with key internal stakeholders such as tech development and support teams, sales, and senior management to shape and drive the product agenda.

s.h: IN ORDER FOR YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU BRING
s.t:
You have 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager in a technical environment or a comparable position, ideally in B2B SaaS, artificial intelligence, or both.
You have strong skills in defining product, product vision, and product family strategy.
You are an effective product advocate who communicates clearly with stakeholders at every level and ensures that feedback from customers and internal teams directly influences product development.
You have a good understanding of software-as-a-service business models.
You are a self-starting leader, detail-oriented, process-oriented, and organized.
You are fluent in written and spoken English.
Your experience with products in computer vision, AI, or video management domains is a plus.

Friendly cooperation at eye level - We live and breathe flat hierarchies with a positive feedback culture.
Innovation where it matters - A challenging position in a company that is changing the world of video data: With you we will make history.
Creative and entrepreneurial playground - Get a chance to be your own master, define your own tasks, actively contribute and implement your ideas. Grow yourself and grow the success of the company with direct influence from day one.
Team spirit celebrates diversity - Numerous events to get to know the teams and meet our great visionaries.

We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.
Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.
We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

You own the product and the priorities behind it. The hard part of that job here is structural: our go-to-market runs vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt.
You sit between Sales and Engineering and translate in both directions. Towards Sales: which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim. Towards Engineering: which requirement is ready to be built, what it needs to be complete, and what we deliberately leave out.
This is an early-stage role and we expect you to shape it rather than inherit it. We are extending the core of the application right now, which means your first decisions land while the product is still taking form. At the beginning, a meaningful part of your work will be spent on customer projects, close to the people whose decisions we model. That is where you see which patterns are worth turning into product.
We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, wild workload, and a go to market with the product and its tech that is a day to day focus and iteration process.
What you'll own
The product roadmap and the reasoning behind it: what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.
The boundary between standard product, configuration, and manual work for one customer.
Requirements that engineering can build from: scope, acceptance criteria, and a clear statement of what is out.
What we can credibly promise a customer, including where the product's limits currently are.
Proofs of Value that you run yourself, and responsibility for individual accounts.
Prototypes you build to test features with customers before we commit engineering time.
How product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering.
Your number: how much of what is project work today is standard product a year from now, and the time from a recognised customer problem to a usable capability.
This role is not for you if your strength is backlog, process and ceremonies, if you need research and design capacity before you can decide, if a complex industrial domain is an obstacle rather than the interesting part, if you don't like data or if you need more than three days before your first customer conversation.

A technical and analytical foundation, engineering, data analytics, data science, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling from a technical degree, technical consulting, or technical product management. You will not write production code, but you need to recognise when a requirement creates technical debt, or is built in a way that cannot be reused at the next customer.
5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. More important than the title: you have owned a product area end to end before, not only a backlog.
Experience deciding under incomplete information, and the ability to explain your trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
You can sit with a plant manager or a controller, understand how they decide today, and leave the room knowing what the product has to do about it.
Good to have, not a cut off: optimization experience, deeper knowledge in manufacturing, supply chain or S&OP, enterprise B2B sales cycles involving operations, IT and controlling, or early-stage startup experience.
German C1 or higher, fluent in English.
NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.

Impact. You work with substance and lead what the product becomes.
Ownership. You define how product works here: what we build, what we decline, and where the boundary between product and project sits. No approval loops.
The people next to you. You work directly with the researchers and modellers, have access to tech deliveries and execute and build on eye level with the founders.
Exposure. You present your own roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, you sit in the core strategy conversations, and you stand in front of the people whose decisions we model.
Feedback speed. You will know directly what you are up to, we speak out loud, we adjust, we grow. Together.
High stakes. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.
Process: Intro call with Dana or Erik, second call with one from the team, a 60 to 90-minute live case exercise on a real customer requirement, then team conversations in person. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.

Job Summary We are seeking a Senior Product Manager for Gigawatt’s Revenue team, the group building an AI-native meter-to-cash platform that turns the utility CIS from a system of record into a system of intelligence. Your mandate is to rethink the meter usage ingest process end to end, from meter to cash.

That means owning how meter data is captured, validated, and turned into accurate billing determinants, and then enabling the platform to use that data more intelligently to power rates, programs, marketing, data science, and beyond, so utilities can better serve their customers.

Get it right, and a utility bills accurately, at scale, with full auditability; get it wrong, and everything downstream breaks. This is an early-stage, build-it-from-the-ground-up role, and the meter is where you’ll start and not where you’ll stop.

As we build the platform, your scope will grow and shift; we’re looking for someone energized by ambiguity who wants to own new areas of meter-to-cash over time. Reporting to the Director of Product: Revenue, you’ll partner closely with utility SMEs, metering experts, and AI engineers to:
Define how meter data is ingested and reconciled across interval and scalar sources.
Run VEE (validation, editing, estimation) and data-quality guardrails on the way into the core.
Assemble precise billing determinants (kWh, TOU-bucketed kWh, demand kW) for the tariff and billing engines.
Set the standard for how meter data flows through our unified model so that Gigawatt handles interval data and VEE natively in the core, not via a bolt-on MDM.

Own Meter: Drive the roadmap for meter data management end to end, from head-end ingest to billing determinants.

Ship Product: Define high-value MVPs, validate correctness against real reads, and iterate fast on edge cases and exceptions.

Engage SMEs Translate metering, MDM, and billing expertise into clear specs, enriched with AI-generated documentation and prototypes.

Execute: Drive with engineering and design to release production-ready features on compressed timelines. Drive the product lifecycle by defining use cases and technical requirements, collaborating on data model design, and conducting product testing to ensure key requirements are met.

Own outcomes Set KPIs (determinant accuracy, throughput, reconciliation rate, exceptions) and manage dependencies across the Revenue platform.

Wear many hats Do whatever it takes to move the platform forward, and take on new areas of ownership as priorities evolve.

Experience: 8+ years in product management, with a proven track record of working directly with utilities to gather requirements and building metering, billing, or complex, data-intensive platforms in the energy sector.

MDM & metering: Strong knowledge of how MDM systems work ingest, interval/scalar data, data quality, VEE and how they feed a billing flow.

Data fluency: Comfort reasoning about pipelines, reconciliation, and data-quality checks; SQL a plus.

AI: Experience applying AI to data validation, documentation, or workflow automation.

Collaboration: Able to bridge SMEs and engineering; strong communication and structured problem-solving.

Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage ambiguity, move fast, and are comfortable with a role that grows and changes as the company scales.

Tools: Experience with Jira, Figma, and standard product management tools.
Location Remote (ideally Bay Area. Chicago, Austin, or Nashville). What We Offer

The chance to shape a transformative AI product in a vital industry with a rock-star team.
Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, remote flexibility, and 401k match.
If you are passionate about modernizing the systems that run America’s utilities, apply today!

We have strong foundations. But to reach more markets, more brands, and more patients, we need a growth platform that gives us capabilities we don't yet have.
This isn't about what to build on the surface. It's about what foundational capabilities unlock the next step change — in conversion, retention, and how fast a new market can go live. Sometimes that's personalisation. Sometimes authentication. Sometimes embedding AI into exactly the right moment in the patient journey. You'll figure that out, own the roadmap, and ship it. The roadmap doesn't exist yet — you'll define it.
You'll work with a cross-functional squad of engineers and designers and:
Define and own the growth platform strategy and roadmap — the foundational capabilities that unlock conversion, activation, retention, and market scalability
Translate platform investments into business outcomes — every capability has a clear hypothesis for how it moves a growth metric, shipped incrementally and not after a six-month build
Embed AI where it genuinely improves outcomes — identifying the moments where an intelligent layer makes the experience materially better
Enable dynamic experiences across landing pages, onboarding, and in-product surfaces — the CMS, feature flagging, and content infrastructure that lets teams move without engineering dependency
Build a tech stack that launches a new market in weeks, not months
This is a platform role, not an infrastructure role. You care about what the platform enables for patients and growth teams — and you ship incrementally to prove it.

You're a product manager who's comfortable in the space between user experience and engineering infrastructure. You think in systems and capabilities — but you never lose sight of the patient on the other end, or the growth team trying to move a metric.
You don't treat platform work as a reason to slow down. You know how to slice a large capability into meaningful increments that ship value fast, and you hold yourself accountable to growth metrics even when the work lives under the surface.
Solid PM experience with meaningful time on platform, growth, data, or infrastructure
You hold the technical and commercial view at once — you know what's being built, why it matters to the patient, and how it moves a metric
Comfortable with ambiguity — you can take "we need to be better at personalisation" and turn it into a sequenced, defensible roadmap without waiting to be told what to build
Adaptable — requirements change and you move with them, without losing sight of where you're going
Comfortable working with data teams — event tracking, user identity, and data models aren't foreign to you
Strong cross-functional instincts — you build alignment across engineering, data, design, and growth without needing authority
Genuinely curious about where AI actually belongs in a product experience
Bonus points for healthcare experience, multi-market platform thinking, or building personalisation engines.

### **V-ZUG Procurement** ###
Der Bereich Procurement verantwortet die strategische Beschaffung von Materialien, Komponenten und Dienstleistungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Als Schweizer Premiumhersteller mit eigener Produktion am Hauptsitz in Zug stellen wir hohe Anforderungen an unsere Lieferanten - und an uns selbst.

Unser Einkauf ist entsprechend professionell aufgestellt: mit klaren Kategorienstrukturen, einem internationalen Lieferantennetzwerk und dem Anspruch, nicht nur Kosten zu optimieren, sondern Partnerschaften zu gestalten, die langfristig tragen.
### **Das bietet dir die Stelle** ###
* Du entwickelst und setzt die Warengruppen- und Lieferantenstrategie für deine Kategorien um - nicht als Verwaltungsaufgabe, sondern als echte Gestaltungsaufgabe: Du entscheidest, welche Lieferanten V-ZUG langfristig begleiten, wo neue Quellen erschlossen werden und wie die Materialversorgung auch in einem volatilen Markt stabil bleibt
* Du steuerst dein Lieferantenportfolio über den gesamten Lebenszyklus - von der Auswahl neuer Partner über gezielte Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ausphasung. Gemeinsam mit dem Supplier Quality Management sorgst du dafür, dass Anspruch und Realität übereinstimmen - durch regelmässige Bewertungen und Audits, die mehr sind als ein Pflichtprogramm
* Du verantwortest das Vertragsmanagement in deinen zugewiesenen Warengruppen im Bereich Mechanik - von der Erstellung über die Verhandlung bis zur laufenden Pflege. Du weisst, was in einem Vertrag wirklich zählt, und bringst interne Stakeholder auf einen gemeinsamen Nenner
* Du führst Ausschreibungen durch, vergleichst Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen fundierte Vergabeempfehlungen und Entscheidungen, die wirtschaftliche und technische Anforderungen optimal vereinen
* Du hast die Kostenentwicklung deiner Vorserien- und Serienartikel im Griff: Du erkennst Potenziale frühzeitig, nutzt sie konsequent und setzt Massnahmen um, die nachhaltig wirken
* Du bist fester Bestandteil von Projekten, koordinierst Materialbedarfe mit Lieferanten und stellst sicher, dass Muster, Prototypen und Serienmaterialien dann da sind, wenn sie gebraucht werden
### **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit** ###
* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaft, Supply Chain Management oder einer vergleichbaren Disziplin
* Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Einkauf mit und weisst, wie man Lieferanten gegenüber souverän Position bezieht - mit Verhandlungsgeschick, das nicht laut sein muss, um zu wirken, und einer Kommunikation, die intern wie extern ankommt
* Du denkst strategisch und analytisch: Du erkennst Marktdynamiken, leitest daraus konkrete Massnahmen ab und entwickelst Einkaufsstrategien, die nicht nur für heute, sondern für morgen tragen
* Du weisst, wofür du stehst und bringst die Klarheit, Durchsetzungsstärke und Überzeugungskraft mit, um das auch zu zeigen: im internen Projektumfeld genauso wie im Gespräch mit externen Partnern
* Der sichere Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, insbesondere SAP, sowie digitalen Tools ist für dich selbstverständlich - kein Aufwand, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage
* Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - schriftlich wie mündlich, klar und mit dem richtigen Gespür dafür, was dein Gegenüber braucht

An Introduction to Primer
Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.
Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.
Watch our showcase >
Read up on our $100m Series C

Which team will you be joining?
Getting paid is only half the story. Understanding and managing those payments is where the real work begins.
In the Financial Operations team we build the tools and infrastructure that let merchants take control of their payments: reconciling funds, monitoring performance, and automating the operations that keep everything running. We also own Global Accounts, giving merchants the ability to hold, manage and move funds across currencies and markets, a foundational capability as Primer expands into more complex, cross-border payment environments.
The team spans Reconciliation, Operations Automation, Global Accounts and FX. As a Product Manager here you will own a sub-area within that: a coherent slice of the product where you own the problems, the prioritisation and the outcomes over multiple quarters.
You will work day to day with a dedicated engineering team and design partner, alongside GTM, and report into the Product lead for the area. Primer is remote-first and globally distributed, and always will be. We run on written thinking, low bureaucracy and real ownership. You build it, you own it, end to end.
What will you be doing?
Owning the outcomes for your sub-area of Financial Operations over multiple quarters, not just shipping a backlog
Defining the problems worth solving in your scope by synthesising merchant feedback, support data, competitive moves and platform constraints

Why This Role
Pricing sits at the centre of everything we do. It shapes what partners earn, what consumers pay, and how much surplus food actually gets saved. Today, pricing decisions are made in different places, for different reasons, without a single team owning the strategy end to end.
We are changing that. We are building our first dedicated Pricing team — and you will be the founding member.
You will start with a concrete, high-value problem: the pricing infrastructure behind our Key Account deals. That's your launchpad — from there, you will have real scope to shape our approach to dynamic pricing, consumer-facing service fees, and pricing strategy across Too Good To Go more broadly. This is a role built for someone who wants to define a domain, not just execute a brief.
The goal behind everything we do is twofold: save as much surplus food as possible, and grow the pie between TGTG, our Partners, and our Consumers — never trading one off against the other.
There is a further dimension to this. We are expanding beyond food into new non-food, non-perishable categories — and that growth brings pricing complexity and opportunity we have not had to solve before. Getting ahead of that, rather than reacting to it, is part of this role.

As Senior Product Manager for Pricing, you will build the foundation for how Too Good To Go prices its marketplace — starting with Key Account deals, then extending across the business.
In the near term, you will design and ship the infrastructure that lets us set, manage, and evolve pricing for Key Account partnerships with the flexibility our commercial teams need.

From there, you will develop a smarter, more dynamic pricing algorithm that responds to supply, demand, and partner economics — replacing static rules with something genuinely intelligent. Alongside this, you will investigate our consumer-facing service fees: how they're structured, how they're perceived, and where there is room to optimise.
Underneath all of it are two questions you will own: how do we price in a way that saves as much surplus food as possible, and how do we grow the pie for everyone — Too Good To Go, our Partners, and our Consumers — rather than shifting value from one side to another? Answering both well means understanding marketplace pricing broadly: the best practices and patterns other two- and three-sided marketplaces use, and what applies to ours.
Pricing decisions rarely stay inside one product's boundaries, so you will work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing is right everywhere it shows up, not just within your own roadmap. You will become the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting your strategy and results to the Global Management Team.
You will also help lay the pricing groundwork for our move into non-food, non-perishable categories — different cost structures, margins, and purchase patterns than the food pricing we know today, and a chance to shape pricing thinking for a new part of the business from the start.

You will be the founding Pricing PM, operating as an individual contributor, with a small dedicated engineering team of around 3-4 developers to start. We will grow the team's scope and headcount as we prove impact, not before. You will report directly to our VP of Product.
This is a new team with a clear starting point, not a fixed script. You will know where to begin — Key Account deals — but how the team's remit, roadmap, and impact grow from there is largely yours to shape. If you want a role where everything is already solved and you are just executing, this isn't it. If you want to help define what great pricing looks like across Too Good To Go, it is.
The role is suited to someone who does not need daily direction — who can set the agenda within that mandate, manage up effectively, and make strong pricing calls with incomplete information.

Build the pricing infrastructure for Key Account deals, giving commercial teams the tools and flexibility to structure partnerships well while keeping pricing logic sound and scalable.
Design and develop a smart pricing algorithm — moving from static, rules-based pricing toward a dynamic model informed by supply, demand, and partner-specific economics.
Investigate consumer-facing service fees: how they're set, how they perform, and how they should evolve to balance consumer value with business sustainability.
Take a holistic view of pricing across TGTG, Partners, and Consumers — optimising for meals saved and for growing the pie for all three, rather than trading one off against another.
Research and apply best practices and patterns from marketplace pricing more broadly, adapting proven approaches to our specific dynamics rather than reinventing from scratch.
Own the roadmap and OKRs for the Pricing team within its agreed mandate, sequencing the work so that early wins on Key Accounts build toward the algorithm and fee strategy.
Work across product teams and the wider organisation — Commercial, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, and Key Accounts — to make sure pricing decisions are right wherever they show up, not just within your own roadmap.
Be the go-to person for anything pricing-related at Too Good To Go, including presenting strategy, models, and results to the Global Management Team.
Anticipate the pricing complexity and opportunity of TGTG's expansion into non-food, non-perishable categories, and start laying the groundwork for pricing them well.
Use data rigorously — pricing experiments, elasticity analysis, partner and consumer feedback — to test hypotheses before scaling them.

Multi-year experience in Product Management with direct, hands-on ownership of pricing.
Experience with pricing in a marketplace or platform business is a genuine differentiator. If you've worked on take rates, dynamic pricing, two-sided pricing trade-offs, or fee structures in a marketplace, you will hit the ground running.
A track record of building pricing algorithms, models, or infrastructure — not just adjusting numbers in a spreadsheet, but shipping systems that price things well and can evolve over time.
Comfort working with quantitative teams (data science, analytics, finance) to translate pricing theory into production systems.
How you work
You are comfortable — and genuinely thrive — working independently, with a high degree of autonomy, especially in the early stages of building a new team.

We are looking for a Senior Growth Product Manager who is also an entrepreneur at heart, someone who can reinvigorate funnels while simultaneously prototyping and launching entirely new product experiences.
We don’t just want someone to manage a roadmap; we want a "Growth CEO" who can reinvent the high-stakes journey from initial sign-up to the first "Aha!" moment and the first purchase.
Your goal is to own the most critical window of the customer lifecycle: a potential customer experiencing our product for the first time and the subsequent choice to purchase a subscription. This includes the journey to the trial, the trial experience, the payment windows, the product mix, pricing and CRM control.
We are looking for a candidate who applies CRO principles not just for incremental gains, but to prototype entirely new ways for parents to discover, experience, and purchase our services.

Prototype, test and implement new funnel approaches. You won't just "tweak" the journey from a customer becoming a lead to making a purchase; you will review all flows to eliminate friction and shorten the time-to-value.
You will expertly translate data to identify "leaks" in the funnel and turn those insights into high-impact product features.
Design and test trial experiences and product mixes that deliver consistent “Aha moments” to more customers leading to significant sales boosts. You will own the conversion engine from sign-up to the completion of the trial.
Activation journeys aren’t just about conversion. You will drive revenue by matching users with the right subscription tiers and value propositions. You will maximise upsell opportunities and ensure customers are matched with the optimal products to not only positively affect ARPU, but also boost LTV.
Partner with diverse teams (Marketing, CRM, Operations) to align acquisition strategies with the highest-converting customer journeys.

5+ years of Product Management experience with a heavy focus on Growth, Activation, and CRO . You should have innate commercial intuition with a proven track record of successful product design.
You possess elite skills in performance tracking and product analytics. You don't guess; you are able to dig into, manipulate, and present data to prove your prototypes work.
Experience in managing international consumer products; you know how to adapt and reinvent funnels for diverse global markets.
Manage the Agile process with our engineering team, ensuring that prototypes are delivered and scaled with technical excellence.
You thrive in a 100% remote, distributed team environment and are a master of tools like JIRA and Slack.
Excellent spoken and written English.

You will report to the Vice President of Product and lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of key capabilities within Elsevier's enterprise nursing workspace.

Prototype and validate cross-product concepts quickly, using customer feedback, AI-assisted tools, and iterative experimentation to refine product direction before development.

Use customer insights, product analytics, and market trends to prioritize investments and guide roadmap decisions.

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.
We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.
When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.
The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.
The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.
In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.
This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week.

Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.

Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.
Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.
Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.
Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.
Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.
Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.
Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.

5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion spent on high-scale search or ranking systems: web search, feed ranking at a large social platform, or a large ad engine.
A background as an engineer, ML engineer, or researcher on a production system in one of those areas. This is a requirement rather than a preference. You will be making tradeoff calls alongside senior search engineers, and you need to have built something at that scale yourself.
Direct experience shipping a search or ranking change end to end, including how it was evaluated and what happened after it shipped.

Product judgment to match the technical depth: you can decide what to build and what to leave, and defend it to both engineers and customers.
